iti32:2.1: dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niriye
iti32:2.3: pāpakena ca sīlena pāpikāya ca diṭṭhiyā
iti32:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ nirayeti.
iti32:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
